description: A majestic deciduous tree that can live over 1,000 years. Supports 2,300 species of wildlife.
funFact: A single oak can produce 70,000-150,000 acorns per year, but only 1 in 10,000 becomes a tree.
evolution: Appeared ~55 MYA. Part of the Fagales order alongside beeches and birches.
threat: Least Concern, but declining due to oak decline disease.
symbolism: Strength, endurance, wisdom. Sacred tree in Norse, Greek, and Celtic traditions.

description: Tracks the sun across the sky. Each head contains up to 2,000 seeds arranged in Fibonacci spirals.
funFact: Sunflowers can absorb radioactive contamination from soil — used at Chernobyl and Fukushima.
evolution: Domesticated ~3000 BCE by Native Americans. One of the first domesticated crops.
symbolism: Adoration, loyalty, longevity. Van Gogh painted 11 sunflower canvases.

description: Nearly impossible to kill. NASA confirmed it removes formaldehyde from air.
funFact: In the wild, it can grow 20m tall climbing trees. Indoors, it rarely flowers.
evolution: Evolved in tropical rainforest understory. Adapted to low light.
threat: Invasive in some tropical regions. Listed as invasive in Australia.

description: Highly toxic. Every part of this plant can kill. Contains tropane alkaloids.
funFact: Used as a poison and hallucinogen for centuries. Known as 'Devil's Trumpet'.
evolution: Part of Solanaceae (nightshade family), which includes tomatoes and potatoes.
symbolism: Danger, deception, dark magic. Featured in Shakespeare's plays.

description: Can grow 91cm in 24 hours. The fastest-growing plant on Earth.
funFact: Bamboo releases 35% more oxygen than equivalent trees. One acre absorbs 25 tons of CO2/year.
evolution: Grasses (Poaceae). Diverged from other grasses ~30 MYA.
threat: Some species endangered. B. vulgaris itself is Least Concern.
symbolism: Flexibility, resilience, emptiness (hollow stem). Central to East Asian philosophy.

description: Grows at 4,200m altitude. One of the highest flowering plants in Europe.
funFact: Can photosynthesize at temperatures near freezing. Flowers are pink to absorb more UV.
evolution: Adapted to alpine conditions over millions of years. Part of Ranunculaceae.
threat: Near Threatened. Vulnerable to climate change — its habitat is shrinking upward.
symbolism: Endurance, purity, the beauty of extremes.

description: Contains nicotine. Kills 8 million humans per year through tobacco products.
funFact: Nicotine is a natural insecticide. The plant evolved it to poison insects.
evolution: Hybrid of N. sylvestris and N. tomentosiformis. Domesticated ~5000 BCE.
threat: Cultivated globally. Wild relatives are threatened.
symbolism: Controversy, addiction, ritual. Used ceremonially by Indigenous Americans for 8,000 years.

description: Only ever grows 2 leaves. Can live 2,000 years. A living fossil.
funFact: Its two leaves grow continuously from the base and split at the tips, creating a tangled mass.
evolution: Order Welwitschiales. Alone in its order. Diverged from other gymnosperms ~100 MYA.
threat: Not globally threatened but protected in Namibia. Slow-growing makes recovery hard.
symbolism: Solitude, patience, the absurd persistence of life.

description: The world's largest flower. 1 meter wide. Smells like rotting flesh.
funFact: No stems, leaves, or roots. A parasite that lives entirely inside Tetrastigma vines.
evolution: Part of Rafflesiaceae. Evolved extreme size to attract carrion fly pollinators.
threat: Endangered. Deforestation in Sumatra threatens remaining populations.
symbolism: The grotesque beauty of nature. Decay as a form of life.

description: Bleeds red resin when cut. Exists only on one island.
funFact: The red resin ('dragon's blood') was used by Roman soldiers, medieval alchemists, and Stradivari violin makers.
evolution: Asparagaceae family. Socotra separated from mainland 6 MYA, leading to unique evolution.
threat: Vulnerable. Climate change reducing fog that sustains the forest.
symbolism: Mystery, isolation, ancient wisdom. A tree from another time.

description: Closes its trap in 100 milliseconds. Feels insects with tiny hairs.
funFact: Must feel two touches within 20 seconds to close. Prevents wasting energy on raindrops.
evolution: Evolved carnivory independently at least 6 times in plants. Venus flytrap lineage: ~65 MYA.
threat: Vulnerable. Endemic to a 120km radius. Poaching and habitat loss.
symbolism: Patience, precision, the trap of beauty.

description: South Africa's national flower. Survives wildfires.
funFact: Its flower head can be 30cm across. Sugarbirds and bees are its main pollinators.
evolution: Proteaceae family. Ancient lineage dating to Gondwana, ~90 MYA.
threat: Least Concern overall, but some subspecies Endangered.
symbolism: Courage, transformation, diversity. Named after the Greek god Proteus.

description: Blooms once every 7-10 years. The inflorescence reaches 3 meters.
funFact: Heats up to 36°C when blooming to spread its rotting-flesh smell further.
evolution: Araceae family. Evolved gigantism to attract carrion beetle pollinators in dense rainforest.
threat: Endangered. Only ~1,000 remain in the wild.
symbolism: Patience, spectacle, the long wait for beauty.

description: Stores 120,000 liters of water in its trunk. Can live 3,000 years.
funFact: The oldest known baobab was 2,500 years old. Several ancient ones collapsed in 2000s.
evolution: Malvaceae family. Native to Africa but also found in Australia and Madagascar.
threat: Not globally threatened, but individual ancient trees are dying from climate change.
symbolism: Life, community, shelter. Called 'the tree of life' across Africa.

description: An epiphyte that grows on other trees. Fragrant flowers last 2-3 weeks.
funFact: One of the most traded orchids globally. Used in traditional Chinese medicine.
evolution: Orchidaceae — the second largest flowering family with 28,000 species.
threat: Endangered in the wild. Over-collected for horticulture.
